pattern_findings.thermal: WSA884x exports amplifier temperature through hwmon, not thermal_zone; WSA883x 3.2 follows hwmon ops/chip_info/register_with_info shape.
pattern_findings.soc_id: WSA SoundWire codecs match via struct sdw_device_id and SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY, not platform-style of_match_table.
pattern_findings.power: Same-generation WSA884x uses devm_add_action_or_reset for regulator/reset cleanup and reset_control optional shared with GPIO fallback.
pattern_findings.function_structure: Same-class upstream drivers avoid downstream proc/debug/info wrappers; 3.2 prunes those scaffolds.

dt_kconfig_makefile.kconfig: SND_SOC_WSA883X depends on SOUNDWIRE, selects REGMAP_SOUNDWIRE
